First, note the date format given is MM-DD-YYYY: 06-22-1274.  
300 days before June 22, 1274:  

1274 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but 1274 mod 100 = 74, not divisible by 400, so not leap).  
Days before June 22:  
June: back 21 days → June 1.  
May: 31 days → April 30 after 52 days total subtracted.  
April: 30 days → March 31 after 82 days.  
March: 31 days → February 28 after 113 days.  
Remaining days to subtract: 300 − 113 = 187 days earlier into previous year.  

Year 1273 is not leap (not divisible by 4).  
From Feb 28, 1273 back 28 days → Jan 31, 1273 (141 days subtracted from 187, leaving 46 days).  
From Jan 31 back 31 days → Dec 31, 1272 (172 days subtracted from 187, leaving 15 days).  
From Dec 31, 1272 back 15 days → Dec 16, 1272.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1272-12-16
